title: Ghoda gaadi kheenchta hai, gaadi ghode ko. Toh gaadi CHALTI kaise hai?
description: Season 2 Episode 9: Action–reaction pairs never cancel because they act on two different bodies; the cart moves because of the ground's push on the horse.
ncert_chapter: NCERT XI Ch 4 (Newton's 3rd law — action & reaction act on different bodies)
exam_focus: JEE: the classic paradox, asked in some form every year
hook_text: Newton ka 3rd law kehta hai gaadi CHAL hi nahi sakti?! 🐎
concept: Action–reaction pairs never cancel because they act on two different bodies; the cart moves because of the ground's push on the horse.
on_screen_cues: two arrows on two different bodies (horse / cart) → "Different bodies → NO cancel" → "Ground pushes horse forward (friction)" → "Newton's 3rd Law · NCERT XI Ch 4"
pinned_comment: Barf pe ghoda gaadi kheench paayega? Kyun nahi? 🧊
suggested_titles: "Ghoda-gaadi paradox — Newton ka 3rd law galat hai?" / "Action reaction cancel kyun nahi hote?"
elevenlabs_script:
Gudiya: [curious] Chintu, Newton ka third law: har action ka equal aur opposite reaction.
Chintu: [cheerfully] Sahi.
Gudiya: [confused] Toh ghoda gaadi ko 100 Newton se kheenchta hai, gaadi ghode ko 100 Newton se peeche. Cancel! Gaadi chalni hi nahi chahiye!
Chintu: [laughs] Yeh sawaal Newton ke time se log pooch rahe hain!
Gudiya: [sarcastic] Toh jawab?
Chintu: [excited] Woh do forces cancel NAHI hote... kyunki woh do ALAG cheezon pe lagte hain!
Gudiya: [confused] Matlab?
Chintu: [cheerfully] Ek force gaadi pe, ek ghode pe. Cancel tab hota jab dono EK hi cheez pe lagte!
Gudiya: [thoughtful] Ohh... toh gaadi pe sirf ghode wala force hai. Toh woh aage jaayegi!
Chintu: [elated] Exactly! Aur ghoda?
Gudiya: [curious] Ghode ko toh gaadi peeche kheench rahi hai... woh aage kaise?
Chintu: [mischievously] Ghoda zameen ko peeche PUSH karta hai... aur zameen ghode ko aage!
Gudiya: [gasps] Zameen dhakka deti hai?!
Chintu: [excited] Haan! FRICTION! Zameen ka dhakka gaadi ke kheenchne se zyada hai... toh pura system aage!
Gudiya: [elated] Matlab action-reaction kabhi cancel nahi hote... kyunki woh kabhi ek cheez pe hote hi nahi!
Chintu: [proudly] Yeh line yaad rakho. JEE ka aadha chapter isi mein hai.
Gudiya: [curious] Toh truck aur car ki takkar mein... force kis pe zyada?
Chintu: [mischievously] Woh next video mein!
